title: Prework Sync & Catchup — Arjun -> Lina (PM / Eng Lead)
body:
Meeting: PM <-> Eng Lead sync (private 1:1 style)
Time: 2026-03-14 10:00am PT (30m)
Purpose: quick alignment on 3 priority topics — (A) recent p95 latency blip on hosted API, (B) Dedicated rollout gating items, (C) Private EU pilot readiness + checklist. Keep decisions small and actionable.

Goals for this 1:1
- Get Lina's read on root cause for p95 spike and decide immediate mitigation (hotfix vs rollout rollback).
- Confirm Dedicated rollout freeze list (what must land before we expand beta).
- Decide go/no-go criteria for EU private pilot (networking, KMS, audit logs).
- Surface any resourcing conflicts that threaten next sprint deliverables.

Context notes (quick snapshot)
- Host metrics (last 24h): host-api p95 token latency: 420ms (baseline 260ms), error rate 0.8% (0.2% baseline). Coincided with a traffic spike + new batching kernel landing (runtime PR #762).
- Dedicated: 3 customers in beta, expect +2 in April. Known blockers: autoscaler instability under mixed model pool (see ENG-5482).
- Private EU pilot: infra checklist mostly green, outstanding: KMS integration test flakiness (PROD-231), audit-log retention policy confirmation from security.

Top agenda (30m)
- 00:00–03:00 Quick check-in + any urgent blockers not listed
- 03:00–12:00 Latency spike: data Lina needs, hypothesis review, immediate mitigation option (toggle new kernel / limit batch window)
- 12:00–20:00 Dedicated rollout gating: list freeze, canaries, fallbacks, timelines
- 20:00–28:00 Private EU pilot: final checklist, who signs off, support playbook
- 28:00–30:00 Actions / owners / calendaring follow-ups

Notes-to-self (things to bring up)
- Ask Lina: can we repro locally with the daily perf workload? If yes, ask for a short repro run today.
- Clarify risk of toggling kernel in prod — rollback speed, cache warming cost.
- Remind about console UX change: new per-route cost breakdown rollout tied to Dedicated GA (need to know if that shipment might slip).
- Confirm whether SRE should own the immediate mitigation or runtime team.

Hypotheses for p95 regression (for discussion)
- Regression tied to runtime PR #762: new kernel selection logic may mis-handle certain seq-len distributions, causing suboptimal kernel choice -> increased latency for 25–50 token requests.
- Autoscaling latency: mix of long-running KV cache fills + sudden traffic from a customer test bucket.
- Network jitter in one region (eu-west-1) + fallback routing to us-west increasing perceived client p95.

Quick data / logs to bring if requested
- Short list of request ids with spike timestamps (I have raw logs from 2026-03-11 09:10–09:40 UTC).
- Flame graph screenshots (perf-run-20260311.png) — link in Confluence page.
- Small test script to reproduce (will paste gcloud curl snippet if they want to run during meeting).

Decision options to propose
- Option A (fast): flip kernel flag for the model shard(s) back to previous selection for 2 hours while we triage. Pros: immediate p95 relief likely. Cons: possible cost regression and longer-term mystery persists.
- Option B (safe): schedule a targeted canary rollback and increase canary sampling to 10% while we run repro tests. Slower but safer.
- Option C (diagnostic): throttle batch window for 1 hour (reduce batching gain) to see if p95 improves; lower risk but increases unit cost.

Dedicated rollout checklist (items to confirm now)
- Autoscaler test coverage for mixed-model pools: PASS? (SRE sign-off)
- Canary plan: defined + rollback script present? (DevOps)
- Billing & quotas: confirm per-tenant throttles for beta customers (Finance/Product)
- Console: per-route dashboard for Dedicated latency metrics visible to beta customers? (Console team)
- Support playbook: on-call rotation + emergency runbook ready? (Support)

Private EU pilot checklist (ask Lina for sign-off owners)
- KMS integration flaky test fixed (owner: Mira)
- Audit logs retention verified vs compliance (owner: Security)
- Network egress path validated for air-gapped config (owner: Infra)
- Customer access & onboarding doc: ready? (owner: Solutions Eng)

Draft follow-ups (post-meeting actions to capture)
- Action 1: If Lina picks Option A, coordinate with runtime on flip and monitor 15/30/60 min marks. Owner: Lina / runtime oncall. Due: EOD today.
- Action 2: If Option B, schedule canary + extra observability dashboards showing kernel selection distribution. Owner: Arjun + Eli. Due: 2026-03-16.
- Action 3: Dedicated: unblock ENG-5482 by adding targeted unit tests covering mixed-pool autoscaler. Owner: Mira. Due: 2026-03-21.
- Action 4: Private EU: finalize KMS regression root cause and mitigation; if unresolved, put pilot behind toggle. Owner: Mira + Security. Due: 2026-03-18.
- Action 5: Console: postpone per-route cost feature if Dedicated GA slips; notify GTM. Owner: Console PM (TBD). Due: 2026-03-20 (tentative).

Personal prep checklist (what I need to do before meeting)
- Paste short log snippets into Slack thread #runtime-ops for Lina to scan (5 min).
- Start a quick repro run on dev with perf harness (15–20 min) and attach results if repro succeeds.
- Pull the canary rollback playbook and note any missing steps (10 min).
- Bring the customer beta list and contact points for Dedicated (3 min).

Tone reminders / soft asks for the meeting
- Keep it decisions-first; if Lina needs deep triage, schedule a follow-up with runtime + SRE.
- Ask for explicit owner and ETA for each follow-up — makes my life easier for customer comms.
- If we choose to toggle, confirm monitoring windows and who tweets the status to the customer.

Open questions to close with Lina
- Who is primary owner for kernel selection rollback? (runtime / infra / SRE?)
- If we throttle batching temporarily, who will sign off on cost impact? (finance or product?)
- Can we commit to a hard date for Dedicated GA by Apr 15 given current blockers?

Post-meeting template I will use to capture decisions (copy during meeting)
- Decision summary (1–2 lines)
- Chosen mitigation and owner(s)
- Short-term monitoring plan (metrics & thresholds)
- Customer comms needed? (who, what, when)
- Follow-up meeting (time + invitees)

Bottom line / my desired outcome
- Small, reversible mitigation that brings p95 back near baseline today OR clear canary plan started. Dedicated and Private pilots remain gated by a short list of engineering items with owners and ETAs in place.

Random scratch thoughts (freeform)
- If kernel-selection logic is brittle, longer-term we should add a perf-safety net that enforces a fallback to the previous kernel when p95 crosses a threshold for N minutes.
- Could we build a "kernel selection shadow run" that samples 1% of requests for new kernel without serving it (compare latencies)? Might be expensive but useful for future rollouts.

---
End of prework. Will update this doc right after the meeting with decisions and fill in the post-meeting action items in JIRA.
